name: Kaneko Sachi
source:
His family runs a liquor store that he plans to take over once he graduates from high school. He is [url=https://vndb.org/c16725]Natsuru[/url]'s best friend. For the time being, he doesn't have any romantic feelings. 

When he was younger, he often saw them together fighting in his neighborhood. Their fighting was so fierce that he knew they were feared by everyone else. Although he doesn't like fighting himself, that changed when he snapped...

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080611175732/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/natuiro_cyara_sachi.html]official website[/url]]
